Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 6, 2026
Last Updated: October 2026
Entity: Venus Digital Agency

1. Overview & Commitment

At Venus Digital ("we," "our," or "us"), your privacy, data sovereignty, and brand confidentiality are our utmost priorities. We engineer bespoke content creation pipelines, omnichannel social media management, AI chatbots, and voice reception automation for enterprise founders, medical leaders, and high-growth brands.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, process, isolate, and safeguard your personal information, client brand assets, communications, and automated conversation logs when you interact with our website (venusdigital.co), book a consultation, or deploy our AI automation systems.

2. Information We Collect

We only collect data necessary to provide high-performance creative and automated services:

  • Client & Contact Data: Name, professional email address, phone number, company name, website URL, and details shared during strategic consultations or Google Meet discovery calls.
  • Brand & Creative Assets: Video footage, audio tracks, brand guidelines, transcripts, logos, and marketing copy provided by you for production, editing, or repurposing.
  • AI & Automation Interaction Logs: Queries submitted to deployed conversational chatbots, caller transcripts recorded through AI reception workflows, appointment scheduling logs, and lead capture summaries.
  • Technical & Telemetry Data: Browser type, operating system, IP address, referral URLs, and interaction patterns gathered to ensure website security and optimal playback performance.
✦ Critical AI Privacy Guarantee:
Your proprietary brand content, client records, and proprietary conversational logs are NEVER used to train public LLM models (such as public OpenAI or Anthropic models). All enterprise AI processing is executed via isolated APIs operating under strict zero-data-retention or private tenant agreements.

3. How We Use Your Data

We process your information exclusively for legitimate commercial purposes:

  • Service Delivery: Scripting, editing, distributing short-form video content, managing social accounts, and maintaining your custom AI infrastructure.
  • Autonomous Reception & Customer Support: Directing inbound client inquiries, answering FAQs according to your approved knowledge base, and booking appointments into your team's live calendar.
  • Consultation & Strategy: Preparing 30-minute strategic audits, analyzing marketing pipelines, and providing tailored performance roadmaps.
  • System Security & Compliance: Preventing abuse, ensuring compliance with telecommunications standards (TCPA, FCC), and maintaining high platform uptime.

4. Third-Party Integrations & Sub-Processors

To deliver modern media and AI automation, Venus Digital integrates with vetted, enterprise-grade cloud platforms and APIs:

  • AI & Voice Synthesis Engines: Enterprise API endpoints (OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, Deepgram) utilized strictly for real-time transcription, processing, and natural voice interaction.
  • Calendar & Communication: Google Workspace (Google Meet, Google Calendar) for seamless consultation booking.
  • Hosting & Storage: Secure cloud infrastructure with end-to-end TLS/SSL encryption and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

5. Data Security & Retention

We employ multi-layer security measures, including HTTPS encryption in transit, encrypted databases at rest, strict role-based access control, and periodic data sanitization.

We retain your information only as long as necessary to fulfill the engagements outlined in your service agreement or to satisfy legal, accounting, and compliance requirements. You may request the deletion of non-essential records at any time.

6. Your Privacy Rights (GDPR & CCPA/CPRA)

Regardless of your geographic location, you retain full rights regarding your personal and corporate data:

  • Access & Portability: Request an export of the personal data and assets we maintain.
  • Correction: Rectify inaccurate, outdated, or incomplete records.
  • Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"): Request the complete deletion of your records and archived assets.
  • Opt-Out: Unsubscribe from marketing updates or strategic follow-ups at any time with a single click.
